items.title: Willie J. Humphrey Interview, 1979-11-29
items.q: Glenn Miller, they had a whole lot of bands out on the road.

ctx.x: You said there were two boats and four bands. But you know.

Well the two biggest bands that I remember, or not the two bands, I had a whole lot of bands that traveled but they were big bands you see. But we had regular work. But these other jobs they had one-nighters like Fletcher Henderson, McKinney's Cotton Pickers. They were the first bands that I can remember during the time, that they got a thousand dollars a night. That was a whole lot of money for a band. Way back there. Well I think they had a band they called Gene Goldkatt out of Detroit, that's where this band…
